votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the ordinance amending the city zoning map by amending the zone from A-20 (Agricultural 20-acre minimum lot size) to R-1-20 (Residential single family 20,000 sq ft minimum lot size) on approximately 20.50 acres located on the northeast corner of 2450 South and 2580 East to allow for a church and a single-family development as recommended by the Planning Commission.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
